name: Olsen's Farthing
summary: Olsen's Farthing lies in ruin beside Silverpine Forest's main trade road. Since the Third War, reanimated thralls have overrun its fields.

sections.title: A Blighted Homestead
sections.body: Olsen's Farthing once worked the fields beside Silverpine's main trade road. Now weeds choke the farmland, and broken buildings mark the loss of the farmstead. Undead thralls roam the grounds, bound to serve and raid under Thule Ravenclaw. Travelers who stray too close risk being slaughtered.

sections.title: The Grasp of Ravenclaw
sections.body: Thule Ravenclaw commands the undead haunting Olsen's Farthing. The powerful necromancer works from Fenris Isle, at the center of Lake Lordamere, where dark sorcery lets him raise and enslave the dead from the surrounding countryside. His servants reach across Olsen's Farthing and threaten the Forsaken as they seek to secure northern Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: What was Olsen's Farthing before the Third War?
faq.answer: Before the Third War, Olsen's Farthing was a productive farm beside Silverpine Forest's main trade road. It supported local commerce and fed Lordaeron's settlements before the kingdom fell to the Scourge.

faq.q: Why is the farm infested with undead?
aliases: who controls the undead at olsens farthing
faq.answer: The farm was destroyed during the Third War, and Thule Ravenclaw seized its remains. He raised the dead as thralls and raiders to terrorize travelers along the road.
Thule Ravenclaw is a dangerous necromancer aligned with the Scourge. From his stronghold on Fenris Isle, he directs undead incursions across Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Does the Horde or Forsaken hold any presence here?
aliases: do forsaken live at olsens farthing
is there a quest hub here
faq.answer: Hostile undead loyal to Thule Ravenclaw overrun Olsen's Farthing. Forsaken scouts and Horde travelers alike face hostile ground there.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, Olsen's Farthing recalls the Scourge threat that still seeks to enslave the dead instead of freeing them.
Clearing the raiders from Olsen's Farthing helps secure the supply road from the Sepulcher northward and the road toward Tirisfal Glades.
